description: Use this to read the result of a check started with check_ai_recommendation, using the check_id it returned. Returns the status (queued, running, done, failed or refused). When done: for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, how many of their answers named the business, which businesses they named instead, and one fix. While a check is queued or running, poll_after_s is the suggested wait in seconds before reading it again. It waits up to about 20 seconds for a running check to finish. It does not start a new check.
name: get_ai_recommendation_result
title: Get the AI recommendation check result
